question: Does preserving online policy state and issuing a legal SDK RESET after GAME_OVER improve score under the same 80-action budget?

method.baseline: Current HDS ranking policy; stop at first GAME_OVER.
method.candidate: Same policy, RNG, and learned statistics; issue legal SDK RESET at GAME_OVER and preserve policy state until the shared action cap.

results.baseline: Current HDS ranking policy; stop at first GAME_OVER.
results.candidate: Same policy, RNG, and learned statistics; issue legal SDK RESET at GAME_OVER and preserve policy state until the shared action cap.

decision.result: REJECT candidate; RHAE tied across all 15 pairs and candidate used more actions.
